goal: flywheel init prompts for store backend and work source on a TTY (with --store/--pg-schema/--source/--repo/--label/--defaults flags pre-answering, and non-TTY behaving as --defaults), writes the choices to flywheel.toml, and validates a postgres DSN from env vars without ever persisting or echoing it.

references: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py:1526-1598 -- current _cmd_init, templates, and parser to extend
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_policy.py -- final config must load via load_policy without error
constraints: Prompts are plain stdin/stdout with visible defaults (sqlite, directory); the all-defaults path is two enters; no new dependencies
Non-TTY stdin with no flags must behave exactly like --defaults: today's scaffold plus [store] backend = "sqlite", no prompts (spec FR-3)
No DSN or credential may ever be written to flywheel.toml or printed; the postgres path prints the env var contract FLYWHEEL_PG_DSN with DATABASE_URL fallback (spec FR-4)

Postgres path: if the DSN env var is set, test-connect with a short timeout and report success or a sanitized warning; if unset, print which var to set; init exits 0 in all cases (spec FR-5); reuse the store factory's DSN resolution rather than duplicating it
Postgres path checks the extra is importable and warns with uv add 'flywheel[postgres]' if not, still writing config

GitHub source prompts: repo defaults from the origin remote when parseable, label defaults to flywheel, done action defaults to comment; validate like load_policy (repo owner/name, done_action in {comment, close}) and re-prompt interactively on invalid input (spec FR-10)
--repo/--label combined with a directory source is an error with non-zero exit
Ctrl-C or EOF mid-prompts must not leave a partial flywheel.toml
Existing flywheel.toml is left untouched in this task (reconfigure lands in init-reconfigure); scaffold dirs stay idempotent
test_init.py pins the current template and output format; update its expectations for the new [store] section and prompts in the same commit
Update the README quickstart line for init only if its wording becomes wrong; no new docs files
Commit with a Conventional Commits message (feat:) before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: No reconfigure flow for existing flywheel.toml
No prompts for agent model, paths, or graders; they stay commented template entries
No multi-source support; single [source] table unchanged
edge_cases: Origin remote absent or not GitHub-shaped -> repo prompt has no default
Both env vars set -> FLYWHEEL_PG_DSN wins silently
--store postgres --defaults in non-TTY writes backend = "postgres" without prompting
